pages.text: $(l)Lumen Mesh$() is a network for FE and item storage.$(br2)$(l)1.$() Place a Mesh Core.$(br)$(l)2.$() Connect devices with Mesh Cable.$(br)$(l)3.$() Feed FE into an Energy Bridge.$(br)$(l)4.$() Install storage prisms in a Prism Drive.$(br)$(l)5.$() Open an Item Terminal.

pages.title: Available Now
pages.text: $(a)Network topology$(), FE buffering, prism storage, the Item Terminal and external-inventory linking are functional.$(br2)$(8)Autocrafting, wireless access and other prototype blocks are not documented as working features.$()
